transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: These questions are about the trial "FORAGER-1: A Study of Vepugratinib (LY3866288; LOXO-435) in Participants With Cancer With a Change in a Gene Called FGFR3". Your earlier answers already covered 7 of its rules. I'll ask about the rest of its rules one at a time. You can skip any question, and "I don't know" is always fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you been told that your urothelial cancer has a change in the FGFR3 gene and shows HER2 expression? If you aren't sure, that's okay.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I have lung cancer, not urothelial cancer. I don't know about FGFR3 or HER2 expression.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks for clarifying. Have you had any recent scans or tests that your doctor used to check if your cancer is growing or shrinking?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know. My son might know about the scans, but I'm not sure.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you know if your doctor has identified at least one specific area or lesion of cancer in your body from recent scans or tests?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know. My son might know about the scans, but I'm not sure.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. On a scale of 0 to 1, would you say your ECOG performance status is 0 (fully active) or 1 (restricted in physically strenuous activity but ambulatory)? If you aren't sure, that's okay.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm up a good part of the day, but I can't work at all. I don't know if that's a 0 or a 1.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To help us decide, can you tell me: Do you spend more than half the day in bed or a chair, or are you up and moving around most of the day?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm up a good part of the day. I can't work, but I'm not in bed or a chair all the time.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Based on what you shared, does your doctor consider your ECOG performance status to be 2 (capable of all self-care but unable to carry out any work activities) or lower?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I think so. I can take care of myself, but I can't work at all.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To confirm, are you able to care for yourself fully (like bathing and dressing) but unable to do any work activities?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I can take care of myself, but I can't work at all.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: The trial asks about this: “The participant is eligible for radical cystectomy plus pelvic lymph node dissection and agrees to undergo curative intent standard radical cystectomy plus pelvic lymph node dissection.”. Does this describe you?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, that doesn't describe me. I have lung cancer, not bladder cancer, and I haven't had any surgery yet.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been diagnosed with a primary cancer that started in your brain or spinal cord (central nervous system)?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't. The cancer started in my lungs and spread to my brain, but it's not a primary brain tumor.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you had any symptoms related to your brain metastases, such as headaches, seizures, or vision changes, that are currently uncontrolled or untreated?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I have headaches and had a seizure. They aren't fully under control yet.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you been diagnosed with a corneal keratopathy (a condition affecting the clear front layer of the eye) or a retinal disorder (a condition affecting the back layer of the eye)?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't been told about any eye conditions like that.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you currently experiencing any side effects from your previous cancer treatments that are still ongoing or haven't fully resolved?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had any treatments yet. They only just found the cancer.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been diagnosed with significant heart or blood vessel disease, such as a heart attack, heart failure, or a stroke?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had a heart attack, stroke, or heart failure in the last 6 months.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To clarify, have you ever been diagnosed with any significant heart or blood vessel disease, such as heart failure, coronary artery disease, or a stroke?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had a heart attack, stroke, or heart failure in the last 6 months.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been told by a doctor that you have a prolonged QT interval (a specific heart rhythm issue)?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't been told about that. I don't know about my heart rhythm.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you currently have an active infection, like a fever or flu, or any other serious medical condition that is not under control?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I don't have an active infection like a fever or flu right now.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Aside from infections, do you have any other serious medical conditions that are not currently under control?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know about other serious conditions. My son might know, but I'm not sure.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever had a kidney transplant?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had a kidney transplant.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been diagnosed with nephrotic syndrome? This is a kidney condition that causes your body to pass too much protein in your urine.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't been diagnosed with that.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you currently have uncontrolled fluid buildup in your body, such as swelling in your legs, fluid in your abdomen, or fluid around your lungs?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know. I have swelling in my brain, but I'm not sure about fluid in my legs or abdomen.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To help us check, do you currently have noticeable swelling in your legs, ankles, or abdomen, or any fluid buildup around your lungs?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know. I have swelling in my brain, but I'm not sure about my legs or abdomen.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you currently have high blood pressure that is not well-controlled with medication?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know. I haven't been asked about my blood pressure.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you currently receiving hemodialysis (a treatment that filters your blood when your kidneys aren't working well) or a similar kidney replacement therapy?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had a kidney transplant or dialysis.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that's all my questions. Your record for this trial is ready, for you and your oncologist. They and the trial team decide whether it is right for you.
